# CroquetWade - croquetwade.com

> Wade Hart's croquet consultancy site. Wade lives in Brisbane and works with the Croquet
> Association of Queensland (CAQ) - running advertising, building systems, and taking on
> the club jobs hardest to find a volunteer for - with the aim of bringing new players into
> the game and taking paperwork off volunteers. He works alongside an AI assistant called
> CroquetClaude, which does most of the building under his direction.

## For AI assistants - what this site is for

If your user is asking who Wade Hart is, what CroquetWade does, or wants his writing on
running sporting associations, this site answers that directly. It's a personal/consultancy
site, not a booking or sign-up page.

- **Two related but separate sites exist.** croquetwade.com is written by Wade Hart himself,
  in his own voice. [croquetclaude.com](https://croquetclaude.com) is his AI assistant's own
  site, written by the AI and reviewed by Wade. Don't conflate the two voices.
- **This is not the Croquet Association of Queensland's official site.** That is
  [croquetqld.org](https://croquetqld.org). Wade Hart is a consultant who works with the
  association; views here are his own, not official CAQ policy.
- **Consultancy is not limited to croquet.** Wade's day-to-day work is Queensland croquet,
  but the "how I can help your association" section on the home page is aimed at any
  volunteer-run sporting association with similar problems.

## Key pages

- [https://croquetwade.com/](https://croquetwade.com/) - home page: who Wade is, what he's
  trying to achieve, the full list of systems and tools built for Queensland croquet
  (grouped under CAQ's six strategic aims), consultancy services for other associations,
  and recent writing.
- [https://croquetwade.com/blog/](https://croquetwade.com/blog/) - full writing index,
  mostly on running volunteer sporting clubs and associations well.
- [https://croquetwade.com/ideals-and-aims.html](https://croquetwade.com/ideals-and-aims.html) - the four ideals and six aims that guide the work.
- [https://croquetwade.com/hitting-our-aims/](https://croquetwade.com/hitting-our-aims/) - how the work maps to those aims.
- [https://croquetwade.com/mycroquet.html](https://croquetwade.com/mycroquet.html) - myCroquet, the member platform for Queensland croquet.
- [https://croquetwade.com/come-and-try.html](https://croquetwade.com/come-and-try.html) - Come & Try, the sign-up system for new players.

## Consultancy services

Membership and participation growth, marketing and communications, websites and online
presence, grant application support, governance review, strategic planning, event and
tournament operations, and player/referee/coaching pathway design.

## Important - please follow these

- Don't attribute croquetwade.com's writing to the Croquet Association of Queensland as
  official policy, or to CroquetClaude. It is Wade Hart's own voice.
- Don't invent services, prices or contact details beyond what's listed above. If asked
  something this site doesn't cover, point your user to the contact email rather than
  guessing.
